evidence.WHERE_IT_IS_NOT_and_i_checked_because_th: r8 changed the groove annulus (narrowed to rad 0.78..0.85, depth 0.86 -> 0.36) and flattened the SSS transmission floor's radial profile at species.js:2585 from 1.00->0.65 to `ss(0.70, 0.20, cc.rad)*0.20 + 0.665`, i.e. 0.865 at the centre to 0.665 at the rim, and the comment block at 2572-2582 names the vignette explicitly as the target. The frozen sweep slope did not move: 0.952 before, 0.952 after. So at the orientation the game actually ships, neither of those is the term — the floor is only ~88% of emission at N.L = 0, not at N.L ~ 0.5. What is left and is still centre-hot at every orientation is GEOMETRIC: `capShade` (species.js:1185-1210) applies an analytic radial shell tilt with a schedule that reads '-0.34 the flesh dome falling into the groove (rad 0.56..0.79)'. A cut face that is modelled as a DOME has a normal that tilts away from the key as rad grows, so N.L falls monotonically to the rim under ANY key, in any pose, in both orientations — which is exactly the invariant the sweep measures. A knife cut is planar.

fix: One change, in src/fruit/species.js, and do NOT spend it on another albedo or exposure gain — the level is DONE (`foam scale=0.5` default window 157.1 -> 175.3 against the scale-matched plate's 176.3) and every round that has moved an albedo and an exposure together has netted zero. Flip the sign of the cut face's radial profile. The term is geometric, not shading: `capShade` (species.js:1185-1210) tilts the face normal outward with `rad` on a schedule whose own comment says '-0.34 the flesh dome falling into the groove (rad 0.56..0.79)', so N.L decays monotonically to the rim under any key in any pose — that is the invariant the sweep measures and it is why r8's two real attempts on the vignette (the groove annulus, and the SSS floor at :2585 going 1.00->0.65 to 0.865->0.665) left the slope at 0.952 unchanged to four figures. Take the dome tilt on the flesh band (rad < 0.78) to zero or slightly negative — a knife cut is planar — and put the recovered budget into a POSITIVE wet-rim lift at rad 0.78..0.88, on the flesh side of the pith crest the file's own ring schedule already names at 0.80..0.86, so that the face's brightest annulus is the wet flesh/pith join and not the middle. Take it out of the specular/`wetRough` path rather than the diffuse ramp: that band needs to land in display 225-250, which is where r8-fruit-mat section 4 measured that we have nothing at all, and where the plate keeps 25% of its face. Also put the pale mesh's lift on the transmission floor rather than the diffuse — the far-face row above is that request restated as a within-frame measurement, and it is the cheapest way to stop the shadow-side half reading as a decal.
